svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Backups and disaster recovery in Project Aether. Cluster state: a K3s etcd snapshot at 02:00 is pulled to the hypervisor's ZFS disk at 02:30, committed to a local restic repository at 03:00 and copied, age-encrypted, to an Object-Locked Backblaze B2 bucket at 03:30. App data: databases are dumped at 01:30 onto an NFS dataset, which the hypervisor snapshots and streams into the same bucket at 04:00. The cloud host runs restic nightly to object storage. Every stage sends a heartbeat to Uptime Kuma on the edge VM only when it succeeds, so silence raises an alert. Drills restore app dumps, an app and the etcd cluster.
svg.text: Three nightly paths, each ending in a different failure domain. A stage that fails stays silent, and silence pages.
